//: *Migration Note: Serilog is DataBank's current logging standard, replacing log4net. This file defines WHERE and in WHAT FORMAT logs are written, so that can change without a recompile. It deliberately does NOT define "MinimumLevel", that's still driven at runtime by ExampleWebService.cs from Web.config's existing <serviceSettings debugMode="..."> setting, via a Serilog.Core.LoggingLevelSwitch, so debug logging can still be toggled per-deployment through Web.config alone, exactly like before, only the sink configuration moved to this file. See LectureNotes.md.
